question: Which form-group is taken from the middle of the northern compartments?
premises: Śarva ādyam mūrti paṣṭakam names the group.
inference: The Śarva-beginning group of eight forms is taken from the middle of the northern compartments.
uncertainties: Paṣṭakam is treated as a group-of-eight term.
plain_english: From the middle of the northern compartments, the Śarva-beginning group of eight forms.
